name: Behavioral Health Billing Services
short_description: Behavioral Health Billing Services provides specialized outsourced billing for mental health, substance use, and ABA practices.
long_description: Behavioral Health Billing Services is a specialized billing company focused exclusively on mental health, behavioral health, and substance use disorder treatment practices. The company provides outsourced revenue cycle management including claims submission, denial management, authorization tracking, and credentialing support. With deep expertise in behavioral health billing codes and payer requirements, the service is designed for practices with complex authorization requirements. Pricing is typically percentage-based, around 5% of collections.
one_liner: Specialized outsourced billing for mental health and behavioral health practices.
best_for: Mental health practices seeking specialized billing expertise
Behavioral health agencies with complex authorization requirements
ABA therapy practices with specialized billing needs
